slug: 2026-02-10 Algeria launches national public-data governance framework (Decree 25-350)

facts.fact: Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb launched Algeria's national data-governance framework on 9 February 2026, a legal, institutional and technical framework for collecting, storing, sharing and using public data, anchored in Presidential Decree No. 25-350 of 30 December 2025 as this source numbers it.

facts.fact: The roundup reports that Algeria gazetted the National Data Governance Framework, a public tool with a unified mechanism for organising, managing and exchanging data among public institutions; it gives no event date, so the update's published date of 2026-06-23 is used (it covers January and February 2026).

Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb presided over the official launch on 9 February 2026 of the national data governance framework (dispositif national de gouvernance des données), set up by Presidential Decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025.

facts.fact: At the 9 February 2026 launch the High Commissioner for Digitalisation installed the national commission charged with following the framework's implementation, made up of representatives of all ministries and national bodies; the High Commission for Digitalisation is named as its author.

facts.fact: Presidential Decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025, signed by President Tebboune and published in the Journal Officiel no. 87, sets up a national data governance framework (classification reference, data-source cataloguing reference, national interoperability system) for public institutions and bodies with a public-service task.
facts.system: Dispositif national de gouvernance des données

facts.fact: The decree names the High Commission for Digitalisation to draw up and update the two references and run the interoperability system, the national council for information systems security to rule on the framework's operation, the personal data protection authority to check compliance of cataloguing and classification, and the information systems security agency to set data security levels.

facts.fact: Presidential decree 25-320 of 31 December 2025 set up a national data governance system, with data classification and data-source indexing references, launched under the national digital transformation strategy 2025-2030.
The National Committee for Data Governance, made up of the heads of the sectoral committees, has been installed to oversee implementation of the national data governance system across all sectors.

Mohamed Louail of the High Commission for Digitalisation says the decree and a decision of the High Commissioner put the system in place; its data classification reference sets five levels, every ministry has been written to to start classifying, and technical workshops explained the classification and indexing references (no event date given; published date used).

The HCN official said data exchange is framed by executive decree 25-320 on national data governance, resting on a classification reference, an indexing catalogue and a national interoperability system.
The HCN official said data exchanges are supervised jointly by the High Commission for Digitalisation, the national personal data protection authority and the information systems security agency.

Mohamed Louail says Presidential decree no. 25-320 of 31 December 2025 formalised the launch of Algeria's national data governance system, which covers data classification and the indexing of data sources.
